KV caches are FP16 in primary cells, but inputs are not held in FP16; W_A=8 and optional KV4 cells depart from the required controls. C1 is referenced without explicitly defining it as the unquantized FP16 baseline. Additional LLaMA comparisons and ratio metrics distract from the specified experiment.
